text:
Emma: Quick heads-up — last-minute AV snag. Room A preamp is spiking and we've decided to move the live stream to Room B. Expect an ~8-10m delay to start. Hold questions in this thread and we’ll keep the Q&A open during the handoff.
Leo: On it. Presenters — can you re-upload final slides to /handouts? I don't see the latency chart update.
Anya: Mic in Room A is clipping when phantom power is toggled. AV team recommends swapping to the condenser in Room B and using the passive DI.
Sam: OBS encoder on the streaming host crashed during prep. I spun up an emergency fallback VM and bridged RTMP into Zoom: rtmp://zoom.fallback/streamkey — starting local record there.
DevOps Bot: deploy-obs-fallback succeeded — pipeline #1987 -> obs-fallback-1 (tag: v23.4).
Emma: Thanks Sam + DevOps team. Recording will come from the Zoom fallback; note captions may run ~15-25s behind for the first 5m while the caption service warms up.
John: Leadership request — can we move the roadmap Q&A to right after intros? There are three external partners on the call who need the clarity earlier.
Katie: Yes — I’ll reorder the deck and flag the two roadmap slides as 'lead-first'. Also will track who asks which question for follow-ups.
Maria: Will the console demo (live terminal) still be captured? If that's not stable, can we get a clipped MP4 after the meeting?
Sam: We can capture the console demo locally on prod-observer and upload a clip to S3 after. Command I'll use: ```ffmpeg -f x11grab -r 30 -s 1920x1080 -i :0.0 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast /tmp/console-demo.mp4```
Anya: Captioning note — I switched the caption stream to low-latency mode and re-synced the captions service. Will monitor for a minute to confirm drift < 2s.
Leo: Slides: uploaded v3 to /handouts/allhands/2026-03-23-roadmap-v3.pdf and notified presenters.
Emma: Action items recap: 1) Room move + mic swap — Anya/AV. 2) Slides uploaded — Leo. 3) Move roadmap Q&A up — John/Katie. 4) Capture demo clip & upload to S3 — Sam. 5) Timestamp Q&A in recording & notes — Maria/Katie. I’ll post a final "go" in 5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
John: Leadership will take the first 10 minutes of live Q's for product clarifications; others will be handled during the open Q&A segment.
Katie: I'll maintain a running timestamp doc during the stream: https://redwood/internal/allhands/notes (I'll paste timestamps here too).
Emma: Okay, we're moving people now. If you're presenting, please be in Room B in 6m and bring your HDMI adapter. Ping @Anya in this thread if you need specific audio routing. :loud_sound:
Sam: Follow-up — once I upload the clip I'll post the S3 link here: s3://redwood-internal/allhands/2026-03-23/console-demo.mp4
Anya: Room B mic check done — levels look clean, no clipping. OBS fallback stream is live, captions on low-latency, doing a quick audio pass.
Emma: Starting countdown — go live in 3. Everyone ready?
All: :thumbsup:
